instruction: PART 2: Find the best definition for the underlined words in the following sentences by choosing A, B, C, D, or E

items.questionText: The minister was sacked for *exploiting* his position for his own personal gain.

instruction: PART 3: Find the synonyms of the words that are underlined by choosing A, B, C, D, or E

instruction: PART 4: The word in capitals at the end of each of the following lines can be used to form a word that fits in the blank space in the sentences. Fill in each space in this way. Spelling mistakes will be penalized.

items.questionText: Jason is always very ______; why don’t you talk the problem over with him? (APPROACH)
The accident was caused by ______ on the part of the driver. (NEGLECT)
Her latest album is a ______ of all her best singles. (COMPILE)
Most ______ individuals have some common characteristics like knowing how to detect your weaknesses and using your weaknesses against you. (MANIPULATE)
She received £40,000 in ______ for her lost eye. (COMPENSATE)
Defenders of the death penalty regard it as the ultimate ______. (DETER)
Greenpeace works to promote awareness of the dangers that ______ our planet today. (THREAT)
Environmental groups want a substantial reduction in the ______ of greenhouse gases. (EMIT)
Being criticized heavily in public, I felt a deep ______ and wanted the ground to swallow me up. (HUMILIATE)

items.questionText: Student success should be a teacher's number one priority. For some students, success will be getting a good grade. For others, it might mean increased involvement in class. You can help all of your students reach their full ______ , regardless of the way they measure success.

She answered all my questions in a professional and ______ manner. Thus, I could finish and submit my project without any delay.

The education system as we know it dates back more than 200 years. It cannot keep up, and ______ change is close. Is a school system without grades the solution? Is a fixed curriculum still relevant? There are lots of questions as such to be answered.

This is no hidden fact that the rural women do most of the manual work in farms and are the ______ of our agriculture. They sometimes spend around 12 to 15 hours a day on agricultural activities and after that they take care of their families and households.
One of the main ______ of the film is the development of the relationship between the boy and his uncle.
